mapper.select: SELECT DORMITORY_ID AS dormitoryId, DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS dormitoryRoomName FROM DORMITORIES WHERE DEL_YN = 'N';

SELECT S.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, S.STUDENT_NAME AS studentName, S.EDU_ID AS eduId, S.PHONE_NUMBER AS phone, S.DORMITORY_ID AS dormitoryId, D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS dormitoryRoomName, CASE WHEN S.DORMITORY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '배정' ELSE '미배정' END AS assignStatus FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID WHERE S.DORM_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT S.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, S.STUDENT_NAME AS studentName, S.DORMITORY_ID AS dormitoryId, D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS dormitoryRoomName FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID WHERE S.DORMITORY_ID IS NOT NULL AND S.STUDENT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT STUDENT_ID FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG WHERE DORM = 'IN' )

SELECT KOL.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, S.STUDENT_NAME AS studentName, S.DORMITORY_ID AS dormitoryId, D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS dormitoryRoomName, KOL.DORM AS dorm FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG KOL INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON KOL.STUDENT_ID = S.STUDENT_ID INNER JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID WHERE KOL.DORM = 'IN'
SELECT KOL.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, S.STUDENT_NAME AS studentName, KOL.DORM AS dorm FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG KOL INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON KOL.STUDENT_ID = S.STUDENT_ID WHERE KOL.DORM = 'OUT'

SELECT KOL.STUDENT_ID AS studentId, S.STUDENT_NAME AS studentName, S.DORMITORY_ID AS dormitoryId, D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME AS dormitoryRoomName, (SELECT DORM FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG WHERE STUDENT_ID = KOL.STUDENT_ID AND DORM='IN' ORDER BY OP_LOG_ID DESC LIMIT 1) AS checkIn, (SELECT DORM FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG WHERE STUDENT_ID = KOL.STUDENT_ID AND DORM='OUT' ORDER BY OP_LOG_ID DESC LIMIT 1) AS checkOut FROM KIOSK_OPERATIONAL_LOG KOL INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON KOL.STUDENT_ID = S.STUDENT_ID INNER JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID WHERE KOL.DORM IS NOT NULL AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY KOL.STUDENT_ID, S.STUDENT_NAME, D.DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME

SELECT DORMITORY_ID as dormitoryId, DORMITORY_ROOM_NAME as dormitoryRoomName, CURRENT_COUNT as currentCount, MAX_COUNT as maxCount FROM DORMITORIES WHERE DORMITORY_ID = #{dormitoryId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE DORMITORIES SET CURRENT_COUNT = CURRENT_COUNT + 1 WHERE DORMITORY_ID = #{dormitoryId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE DORMITORIES SET CURRENT_COUNT = CURRENT_COUNT - 1 WHERE DORMITORY_ID = #{dormitoryId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
